breaking.change: Removed the obsolete author-OGT formatter, its MCP tool and the creator's ignored --choices switch.
breaking.fix: Author TypeScript declarations through og add/og set and discover creation flags with og create --creation; omit --choices.

breaking.change: Development pages accept only structured source edits naming scene, entity, component, field and value, and emit source_changed on the dev stream and probe wire. Source file/line/column metadata is development-only; publish scenes carry none.
breaking.fix: Send {og:'dev',v:1,from:'host',type:'edit',id,edit:{scene,entity,component,field,value}} in the same document/origin. Handle edit_result and source_changed; computed values are refused with their location and no write. Do not retain runtime overrides or send source text.

added.summary: Recooked scene fields update every live placement and later instantiations from the cooked scene, preserving simulation changes to unedited fields. No runtime override store or writeback path is retained. Entity-tree changes ask for a restart rather than patching mismatched rows.

Generate schema-checked content declarations, nested game source and playtests from the CLI or MCP. Explicit --replace updates supplied code/tests under the source lock. Set edits project/content literals through the TypeScript AST, validates before committing, resolves inherited fields to their defining prefab, then incrementally cooks. JSON results include file, line, column and old/new values; computed expressions report their location without writing.

Creation returns structured identity, choices, file lists and failures without prompts. Help exposes creation discovery, detailed model/projection/server options, model compare/bake and flow check-cuts; new shows the full create help.
